sentences.en: The Upper House seems bent on defeating any reform bills.
sentences.zh: 上议院似乎决心挫败任何改革法案。

sentences.en: The allies defeated the evil empire in the fierce battle.
sentences.zh: 盟军在激烈的战斗中击败了邪恶帝国。

sentences.en: What's more, our first battle is to defeat that dragon!
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，我们首先必须打败那条龙！

senses.zh: 击败；挫败（某人）；阻止达成（目的）；反对（动议或提议）；（使）无法理解；（使）无效
